pages.text: Hauffiosaurus is a genus of pliosaurid plesiosaur known from the Posidonia Shale of Germany and the Whitby Mudstone of the UK. The holotype is a nearly complete and articulated skeleton reaching 2.4 meters in length. Hauffiosaurus’s skull is particularly thin and elongated for an Early Jurassic plesiosaur, which helps it stand out amongst its peers.
